name: Central Automotive Products Ltd
summary: Central Automotive Products Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the import, export, and wholesale distribution of a diverse range of automotive components and accessories. Its extensive product catalog encompasses engine, filter, and cooling system parts, as well as chassis, brake, and clutch components. The company further provides electrical and chemical parts, air conditioning components, shock absorbers, ignition coils, CV joints, clutches, and various engine oils. Founded in 1943, the firm is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
